cases.role_summary: Senior Advanced Analytics Analyst | Commonwealth Bank

career_verdict.hiring_focus: Advanced analytics delivery in financial-crime operations: analytical scripting + data visualization + domain-context decision support.
career_verdict.for_you: Strong analytics execution signal, but role-fit credibility depends on proving financial-crime domain depth and regulated-context POC impact.
must_not_say: Do not claim clear domain fit from generic leadership or stakeholder narrative alone.
Do not frame team-leadership posture as the main proof for analytical scripting buying points.

slot0.human_reason: Adjudicated from frozen contract: this candidate carries direct + medium + coverage-eligible role-conditioned proof for bp_advanced_analytics_proficiency_analytical, while competing leadership/translation winners are adjacent + none + ineligible.

slot1.human_reason: Snippet adjudication confirms no defensible slot1 winner for bp_financial_crime_domain_knowledge: top candidates c6f86bd1..., 3acf0174..., and 58636254... are all adjacent + coverage none + low strength, with snippets focused on dashboards/team leadership/strategy budget rather than explicit financial-crime domain proof.

biggest_risk.human_reason: Financial-crime domain expertise and regulated-context application are not strongly evidenced by the current winning cards.

quick_checks.expected_question_intent: Validate domain-depth proof: recent financial-crime use cases, decision impact, and regulated delivery constraints.
quick_checks.human_reason: Highest-information uncertainty is domain credibility, not generic analytics seniority.

what_this_role_adds.expected_angle: Regulated-domain analytics ownership at higher consequence and governance depth.
what_this_role_adds.human_reason: Role adds domain-specialized career capital beyond broad analytics leadership narrative.

cta.expected_angle: Calibrate with domain-proof examples first, then tailor CV around scripting + financial-crime outcomes.
cta.human_reason: Without domain proof, confidence should remain calibrated and evidence-first.

cross_surface.expected_thesis: Strong analytics operator with incomplete financial-crime proof; advance only with domain-calibration evidence.
cross_surface.human_reason: All surfaces should converge on domain-proof gap rather than generic leadership strength.
